source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape dominated by gnarled pines, layered rocks, pale water channels, distant mist washes, and sparse bamboo/shrub accents. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_mist_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the loose upper-center grove of fine-leaved bamboo or leafy trees emerging from pale mist, including the staggered clusters of drooping foliage and faint horizontal wash bands behind them.

motifs.name: left_sweeping_pine_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the large pine mass entering from the left edge, with curved trunks and branches supporting dense starburst pine-needle clusters.
must_preserve: small dotted bark and twig accents
layered green wash within needle masses

motifs.name: central_ancient_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the monumental central gnarled pine, including its split trunk, exposed twisting roots, high branching structure, and surrounding needle clusters, but not the supporting rock mass as an independent object.
must_preserve: dark ink knots and root lines

motifs.name: midground_layered_riverbank
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal midground riverbank and water channels behind the central pine, with terraced earth shelves, pale water openings, and low receding banks.

motifs.name: right_midground_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side midground group of small trees and shrubs, including the taller drooping leafy tree, lower rounded shrub masses, and sparse bare-branched tree near the water.
must_preserve: light separation from surrounding mist and water

motifs.name: central_foreground_rock_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large ochre-gray rock formation at the base of the central pine, including stacked boulders, ridged surfaces, crevices, and small dotted vegetation along ledges.
must_preserve: small dotted moss and shrub accents

motifs.name: right_cliff_bamboo_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the right-edge cliff and vegetation cluster with vertical bamboo-like foliage, a small rocky ledge, and interlaced dark branches descending along the margin.
motifs.role: side cliff with bamboo and shrubs

motifs.name: lower_right_boulder_island
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right rounded boulder island with low bamboo tufts and shrubs, surrounded by pale water and soft shoreline washes.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
